name: The Fragments Within
summary: "The Fragments Within" is the concluding task in the investigation of the mysterious red crystal jutting from the cliffs east of Auberdine. By using purified moonwell water, you reveal grim organic remains encased within the stone, reporting your eerie findings back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea.

sections.title: A Grim Revelation
sections.body: Pouring blessed moonwell water over the crimson crystal clears away the murky exterior, exposing what lies trapped beneath its polished surface. Suspended inside the dense mineral are several small bone fragments and half of a humanoid jawbone. The stone encasing them is extraordinarily tough—so durable that even formidable spells would struggle to crack it open. Whatever entity or artifact spawned these remains, it has been preserved in uncanny isolation above the Darkshore coastline.

sections.title: Reporting to Auberdine
sections.body: Returning to Auberdine, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea takes note of your disturbing discovery. Rather than offering definitive answers, the revelation only raises more concerns among the local night elf leadership. Glynda promises to present the findings to the town council, though she takes solace in the fact that the strange crystal sits high in the eastern cliffs, far enough from town that it poses no immediate danger to the residents.

faq.q: What is trapped inside the red crystal?
faq.answer: Washing the crystal with sanctified moonwell water makes it transparent enough to spot several bone fragments and half of a humanoid jawbone embedded deep inside.

faq.q: Can the crystal be broken open to inspect the bones?
faq.answer: No. The crystal is exceptionally resilient. Even the strongest forms of magic would find breaking through its structure nearly impossible, leaving the exact identity of the bones a mystery.

faq.q: Who do you report the findings to?
aliases: who turns in the fragments within
faq.answer: You report your findings to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea, who is stationed in the port town of Auberdine.

faq.q: What will the Sentinels do about the crystal?
aliases: what happens next with the crystal
faq.answer: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea plans to inform the council in Auberdine so they can deliberate on potential actions. However, because the crystal rests high in the eastern cliffs, it is not viewed as an urgent threat.

angles.text: The discovery of humanoid bones suspended in strange crystal along the mountain borders of Ashenvale and Felwood warrants careful vigilance from the Sentinels guarding Darkshore.
The mysterious mineral resists natural wear and high magic alike, serving as a curious anomaly against the traditional balance of the wild.
